raw_sections.summary:
Career Objectives: -
Results-driven and growth-focused professionals committed to delivering excellence within dynamic, forward-thinking organizations. Skilled in active listening and confident communication to enhance collaboration and strengthen team performance. Adaptable and quick to learn, with a strong desire to contribute effectively toward organizational success while pursuing continuous professional development.
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience:
Experienced professional in the investment banking and fund accounting sector with expertise in trade settlement, reconciliation, and fund accounting. Well,-versed in the complete trade life cycle, including booking trades and preparing trade confirmations based on client instructions. Skilled at ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance across operational processes.
Organization: Inter Continental Exchange
August :2023- Present
Designation: - Trade Operations Analyst-II Process: -
Trade Settlement
Roles and Responsibilities: -
➢ Monitored real time trade flow in system, ensuring trades are accurately captured, validated, and
ready for clearing settlement
➢ Identify, investigate, and resolve trade breaks and exceptions in real time by directly liaising with
traders, clearing members, and settlement desks.
➢ Drive trade settlement coordination, ensuring smooth handover between front and back office while
meeting tight market deadlines.
➢ I resolve trade breaks in system and exception to meet T+1 settlement deadlines while minimizing
regulatory risk and Buy-in
➢ Managed client escalation on trade status and settlement ensuring SLA adherence. ➢ Performing root cause analysis on trade mismatched to reduce fails and improve settlement. ➢ Need to regular communicate with brokers and counterparties on settlement status and fails
resolution.
➢ I coordinate with risk, legal and compliance to close fails with in T+3 and regulatory timelines. ➢ Produce and present regulatory and market activity reports (monthly, quarterly, annual) to senior
management, ensuring compliance with exchange rules. Liaise with clients, traders, senior leaders, and support staff to facilitate trade confirmations and problem resolution.
Organization: -Societe Generale
Jan 2022-June2023
Designation: Fund Accountant
Process: Fund Accouting
Roles and Responsibilities: -
➢ Performing end to end fund valuation and striking of daily and weekly Nav’s
➢ Performing daily cash reconciliation, identify the discrepancies, coordinate with internal team and
external teams to resolve the break within stipulated period of time
➢ Performing end of day (EOD process)- unit reconciliation
➢ Working with custody for timely matching and settlement of trade
➢ Checking of prices for the securities, trades booked, income received and benchmark of the funds.
➢ Booking and Reconciliation of units (Subscription & Redemption) between Transfer Agent and
fund accountant.
➢ Complete reconciliation for the NAV related cash Break
➢ Preparing and delivering of monthly, Quarterly, Half yearly and Annual audit reports to the client.
Organization: Accenture (Societe Generale)
April 2019-Dec 2021
Designation: -Analyst
Process: Trade Settlement and Reconciliation
Roles and Responsibilities: -
➢ Handling trade settlement for equity and fixed income securities covering with European Market and
Domestic markets
➢ Booking the trade, sending the trade confirmation based on the information received
from clients.
➢ Working coverage area include pre-settlement and post settlement and fails management activities
from the clients
➢ Removed the trades which are struck into various queues and performing trade repairs to achieve
STP and reducing the trade issues.
➢ Working with onshore team to re-instruct the trade from one market to another market. ➢ Worked on corporate actions like Acquisition, merger & stock splits etc.
